description: Use when an agent needs recent issuer freezes of USDC, EURC (Ethereum, Base) and USDT (Ethereum), or whether an address is frozen now. Input: optional address, days (1-7, default 1), chain (all, ethereum, base), token. Output: JSON events (token, chain, freeze/unfreeze/destroy_funds, address, amount, block, approx time, tx), counts per token, live frozen status per token for the address. Issuer action, not a sanctions list. Example: ?days=1 Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: Only events for this address, plus its live frozen status on each token

name: stablecoin_freezes
title: USDC / USDT / EURC issuer freezes: blacklist, unblacklist and destroyed-funds events, address status
